params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DocumentNumber, LineNumber ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.DocumentNumber = D.DocumentNumber
   AND T.LineNumber = D.LineNumber

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.SystemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.SystemModifiedAt > T.SystemModifiedAt
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  T.SystemId              = D.SystemId,
  T.Amount                = D.Amount,
  T.AmountIncludingVAT    = D.AmountIncludingVAT,
  T.BillToCustomerNumber  = D.BillToCustomerNumber,
  T.Description           = D.Description,
  T.Description2          = D.Description2,
  T.LineAmount            = D.LineAmount,
  T.LineDiscountPercentage= D.LineDiscountPercentage,
  T.LineDiscountAmount    = D.LineDiscountAmount,
  T.InvoiceNumber         = D.InvoiceNumber,
  T.OrderLineNumber       = D.OrderLineNumber,
  T.OrderNumber           = D.OrderNumber,
  T.PostingDate           = D.PostingDate,
  T.Quantity              = D.Quantity,
  T.SellToCustomerName    = D.SellToCustomerName,
  T.SellToCustomerNumber  = D.SellToCustomerNumber,
  T.ShipmentDate          = D.ShipmentDate,
  T.ShipmentLineNumber    = D.ShipmentLineNumber,
  T.ShipmentNumber        = D.ShipmentNumber,
  T.SystemCreatedAt       = D.SystemCreatedAt,
  T.SystemCreatedBy       = D.SystemCreatedBy,
  T.SystemModifiedAt       = D.SystemModifiedAt,
  T.SystemModifiedBy       = D.SystemModifiedBy,
  T.Type                  = D.Type,
  T.UnitCost              = D.UnitCost,
  T.UnitCostLCY           = D.UnitCostLCY,
  T.UnitPrice             = D.UnitPrice,
  T.VATPercentage         = D.VATPercentage,
  T.VATBaseAmount         = D.VATBaseAmount

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
  SystemId,
  Amount,
  AmountIncludingVAT,
  BillToCustomerNumber,
  Description,
  Description2,
  DocumentNumber,
  LineAmount,
  LineDiscountPercentage,
  LineDiscountAmount,
  LineNumber,
  InvoiceNumber,
  OrderLineNumber,
  OrderNumber,
  PostingDate,
  Quantity,
  SellToCustomerName,
  SellToCustomerNumber,
  ShipmentDate,
  ShipmentLineNumber,
  ShipmentNumber,
  SystemCreatedAt,
  SystemCreatedBy,
  SystemModifiedAt,
  SystemModifiedBy,
  Type,
  UnitCost,
  UnitCostLCY,
  UnitPrice,
  VATPercentage,
  VATBaseAmount
)
VALUES (
  D.SystemId,
  D.Amount,
  D.AmountIncludingVAT,
  D.BillToCustomerNumber,
  D.Description,
  D.Description2,
  D.DocumentNumber,
  D.LineAmount,
  D.LineDiscountPercentage,
  D.LineDiscountAmount,
  D.LineNumber,
  D.InvoiceNumber,
  D.OrderLineNumber,
  D.OrderNumber,
  D.PostingDate,
  D.Quantity,
  D.SellToCustomerName,
  D.SellToCustomerNumber,
  D.ShipmentDate,
  D.ShipmentLineNumber,
  D.ShipmentNumber,
  D.SystemCreatedAt,
  D.SystemCreatedBy,
  D.SystemModifiedAt,
  D.SystemModifiedBy,
  D.Type,
  D.UnitCost,
  D.UnitCostLCY,
  D.UnitPrice,
  D.VATPercentage,
  D.VATBaseAmount
)
"
